review_description: One of the more expensive system quotes and the communications so far have been poor. 8 weeks after paying deposit am still waiting for even one of the install team to get back to set up a date. Will look at getting refund and going elsewhere.
My only negative comment is I should have been told how long it would take from start to finish. It took far longer than I expected by the time the electricity supplier went through his process.

Very professional team, friendly technicians. The system is of good quality and the installation work is excellent. We have had this system for about a year now and there has been zero problems so far.
